scope: Official-source directory and public-page reachability checks only; no personal claimant database access or entitlement verification.
important: Searching is generally free on official government sites.
No government-wide database contains every type of unclaimed money.
A possible name match is only a lead; verify address, ownership, dates, and agency requirements.
Never pay an upfront fee to search an official state unclaimed-property database.
The bot never submits claims, signs declarations, contacts agencies, or handles payments.

sources.name: South Carolina Unclaimed Property
sources.how: Search your current and former legal names and prior states of residence.

sources.name: NAUPA official state directory
sources.how: Open each state's official program; search every state where you lived, worked, or did business.

sources.name: MissingMoney nationwide search
sources.how: Search participating state databases, then complete any claim on the official state portal.

sources.name: USA.gov unclaimed money guide
sources.how: Use its category-by-category links; there is no single federal database.

sources.name: U.S. Treasury unclaimed assets guidance
sources.how: Identify the agency and payment type; contact the responsible agency.

sources.name: U.S. Department of Labor back wages
sources.how: Search the Wage and Hour Division Workers Owed Wages tool for employers and workers.

sources.name: Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation missing participants
sources.how: Search for certain benefits from terminated private-sector defined-benefit plans.

sources.name: FDIC unclaimed deposits
sources.how: Check whether a failed FDIC-insured bank held an unpaid insured deposit.

sources.name: NCUA unclaimed deposits and shares
sources.how: Check accounts at liquidated federally insured credit unions.

sources.name: U.S. Courts Unclaimed Funds Locator
sources.how: Search court-held bankruptcy funds; court procedures and proof of entitlement apply.

sources.name: HUD/FHA refunds
sources.how: Use HUD's official FHA resources if you had an FHA-insured mortgage; confirm current refund lookup instructions.

sources.name: VA unclaimed insurance funds
sources.how: Relevant only to eligible current or former policyholders and beneficiaries.

sources.name: IRS refund status and missing refund help
sources.how: Use only for a tax return/refund you filed or reasonably expect; the bot cannot see IRS private records.

sources.name: SEC claims and distributions
sources.how: Check whether an SEC enforcement distribution relates to an investment you held.

sources.name: U.S. Railroad Retirement Board
sources.how: Relevant to qualifying railroad workers and eligible family members.

sources.category: SC county tax-sale and foreclosure surplus
sources.name: South Carolina county offices and court records
sources.how: Check county treasurer/tax collector and clerk of court records. A surplus listing alone does not prove you are entitled.

sources.name: South Carolina procurement
sources.how: Potential earnings, not money already owed. Bid/contract rules and performance costs apply.
